entries.label: Taunt
entries.rule: Enemies must attack Taunt units first

entries.label: Rush
entries.rule: May attack units, not heroes, on summon turn

entries.label: Charge
entries.rule: May attack units and heroes on summon turn

entries.label: First Strike
entries.rule: Deals damage before non-First-Strike units

entries.label: Poisonous
entries.rule: Destroys any unit it damages

entries.label: Lifesteal
entries.rule: Damage dealt heals your hero

entries.label: Reborn
entries.rule: First death: return at 1 health without Reborn

entries.label: Divine Shield
entries.rule: Negate the first damage instance, then lose it

entries.label: Trample
entries.rule: Excess damage to a unit hits its hero; a unit tramples only when it attacks

entries.label: Cleave
entries.rule: Also damages units adjacent to the target

entries.label: Pierce
entries.rule: Its damage ignores Armor

entries.label: Indestructible
entries.rule: Can't be destroyed or damaged, can't be in Defense Position and never has Taunt; can be exiled or tributed

entries.label: Immutable
entries.rule: Text can't be changed or transformed. While in play, Spells, Field Spells and Field Traps can't target it

entries.label: Stack
entries.rule: May be played onto an occupied zone

entries.label: Can't attack
entries.rule: Cannot declare attacks

entries.label: Armor
entries.rule: Reduce each damage instance by X

entries.label: Lucky
entries.rule: Repeat a luck-based roll X extra times, keep the best; a coin flip is one, heads its better side unless the card says otherwise; Lucky given to it adds to X

entries.label: Animated
entries.rule: A Field Spell or Trap with stats that becomes a Unit in an open unit zone when it fires or enters the field, or as it gains stats

entries.label: Animated on your turn
entries.rule: A Unit on your turn; back in its backrow on your opponent's

entries.label: Brittle
entries.rule: At the start of turn, after a full turn cycle, the count drops by 1; at 0 the card is destroyed

entries.label: Spell Damage
entries.rule: Your Spells deal X more damage per hit

entries.label: Immune to Spells
entries.rule: Spells can't target it or affect it

entries.label: Windfury
entries.rule: Can attack twice each turn

entries.label: Frenzy
entries.rule: After it attacks and destroys a unit, it may attack again

entries.label: Temporary
entries.rule: At the end of its owner's turn the count drops by 1; at 0 the card is discarded from their hand. Temporary alone is Temporary 1

entries.label: Deft
entries.rule: Can attack and switch position in the same turn

entries.label: Untributable
entries.rule: Can't be Tributed, by any cost or effect

entries.label: Equip
entries.rule: May be played onto one of your Units, fusing into it

entries.label: Ranged
entries.rule: Takes no damage back when it attacks, unless the defender is Ranged

entries.label: Flying
entries.rule: Only Units with Flying or Ranged can attack it, unless it is in Defense Position. It may be played into your backrow as well as into a unit zone

entries.label: Flexible
entries.rule: Can be played into your backrow as well as into a unit zone, and is a unit in either. Every Flying unit has it

entries.label: GIGA
entries.rule: Fills two adjacent lanes in both rows, four zones, and is in both lanes for every rule that reads one

entries.label: Cloaked
entries.rule: Can be played face-down as a Trap. Activate: Reveal

entries.label: Crater
entries.rule: Locks its zone when it arrives as a Unit, or when it is revealed as a Trap

entries.label: Flashback
entries.rule: Can be played from your graveyard once, at its cost

entries.label: Tradable
entries.rule: In your main phase, put it from your hand into your deck at a random position and draw a card, at no mana. One Trade per turn

entries.label: Starship Piece
entries.rule: When it dies, a copy of it fuses into your Dormant Starship, which is summoned first if you have none

entries.label: Starship
entries.rule: A tag: your Starship, Dormant or launched, built from the Starship Pieces fused into it. Every Starship has Flying and Ranged

entries.label: Can't Defend
entries.rule: Never in Defense Position

entries.label: Can't be attacked
entries.rule: No attack may target it

entries.label: Evasive
entries.rule: No attack may target it, and it can't be in Defense Position

entries.id: Only Units in this lane can attack this
entries.label: Only Units in this lane can attack this
entries.rule: An attack on it is legal only from the enemy unit zone of its own lane

entries.label: Berserk
entries.rule: While Berserk, at the start and end of its controller's turn this attacks its own hero

entries.label: Frozen
entries.rule: Can't attack, switch position or use its Activate until it thaws: it loses its next chance to attack or switch, and thaws at the end of the turn it could have done it

entries.label: Dormant
entries.rule: On the field and filling its zone, but out of play until it awakens: it can't attack, be attacked or be targeted, no effect reaches it, and its auras and triggers are off. An awakened card is never Dormant again

entries.label: Combat keyword
entries.rule: One of the keywords Units fight with: Taunt, Rush, First Strike, Flying, Ranged, Poisonous, Reborn, Divine Shield, Windfury, Cleave, Deft, Lifesteal, Pierce, Trample

entries.label: Cry
entries.rule: When you play this card or an effect casts it. Never when it enters play otherwise

entries.label: Death
entries.rule: When sent from the field to the GY

entries.label: Start of turn
entries.rule: Controller's turn start, before the draw

entries.label: End of turn
entries.rule: Controller's turn end, before cleanup

entries.label: Once per turn
entries.rule: Activated ability limit

entries.label: Aura
entries.rule: Effect while in play

entries.label: Combo
entries.rule: Extra effect if X or more cards were played earlier this turn

entries.label: Echo
entries.rule: Recast this card X more times

entries.label: Cast on draw
entries.rule: Plays itself on draw, then draw again

entries.label: Quickdraw
entries.rule: Starts in your opening hand instead of a draw

entries.label: Float
entries.rule: The mana a player leaves unspent when their turn ends. "Float reduces cost": whenever you Float, this costs that much less

entries.label: Activate
entries.rule: Once per turn on your turn, click the card to do an effect; "Activate X" up to X times per turn, "Activate ♾️" any number of times

entries.label: When this awakens
entries.rule: When this Dormant card awakens

entries.label: When launched
entries.rule: When the Starship this is fused into launches, after its Cries

entries.label: Discover
entries.rule: Choose 1 of 3 options

entries.label: Tribute
entries.rule: Playing this also costs X of your Units, which go to the graveyard

entries.label: Embiggened
entries.rule: An embiggen card has two prices. Its normal version costs the cheaper one; its Embiggened version costs more and does more.

entries.label: Recruit
entries.rule: Summon from deck, scanning top down

entries.label: Fuse
entries.rule: Combine effects, stats and cost, cost capped at 4

entries.label: Transform
entries.rule: Replace a card with another in place

entries.label: Vanilla
entries.rule: Remove a unit's text and return it to its printed stats

entries.label: Lock
entries.rule: Zone can't be played into

entries.label: Choose one
entries.rule: Modal effect

entries.label: Counter
entries.rule: Cancel a card being played or cast

entries.label: Steal
entries.rule: Take control

entries.label: Unlock
entries.rule: A Locked zone accepts plays again

entries.label: Flicker
entries.rule: The card leaves the field then re-enters the same zone at once

entries.label: Bounce
entries.rule: Return to controller's hand

entries.label: Nerf
entries.rule: Weaken a card: one change per application

entries.label: Buff
entries.rule: Strengthen a card: one change per application

entries.label: Plague Counter
entries.rule: Counter on a permanent, any number, reset on leaving the field

entries.label: Set health
entries.rule: A hero's health becomes N

entries.label: Redirect
entries.rule: A hit, a chosen target or an attack moves to another

entries.label: End the turn
entries.rule: The turn ends from an effect

entries.label: Trigger a Cry
entries.rule: Run a unit's Cry again

entries.label: Look at a hand
entries.rule: See the opponent's hand in a prompt

entries.label: Allure
entries.rule: Steal the marked enemy permanents at the start of your next turn; one you have no room for is destroyed

entries.label: Freeze
entries.rule: The Unit loses its next attack or position switch, and thaws at the end of the turn it could have made one

entries.label: Awaken
entries.rule: A Dormant card awakens now

entries.label: Launch
entries.rule: Your Dormant Starship awakens: every Cry fused into it fires, then every When launched

entries.label: Jade Counter
entries.rule: A public count each player has, that only rises

entries.label: Exile
entries.rule: Send to the exile pile, from anywhere; it triggers no Death

entries.label: Hand size
entries.rule: How many cards a hand holds, set for the rest of the game

entries.label: Mark in a hand
entries.rule: Mark cards in a hand; a later effect acts on the ones still there

entries.label: Radiant
entries.rule: Raise a card to its Radiant form. In hand or deck: cost unchanged, stats and text swap to the radiant form.

shortReminders.Cry: When you play this card or an effect casts it. Never when it enters play otherwise
shortReminders.Tribute: Playing this also costs X of your Units, which go to the graveyard
